ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized spots, resulting in a low macro-level contrast ratio across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across approximately 95% of the visible surface area; high-contrast white mottling is localized in small circular clusters at the distal tips and sparse focal spots near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, rounded U-shaped depression with a wide pixel angle of approximately 140 degrees and a low-depth bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern containing jagged peaks and valleys with varying amplitudes (approx. 5-15 pixels) distributed along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong bilateral convexity with an upward sweep ending in sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular clusters of high-intensity white pixels localized on the outer distal edges of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent dark curvilinear rake mark is visible on the inner-middle section of the right lobe; faint white linear scratches are detectable near the median notch area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; distinct rake marks/abrasions on the right lobe.
